working_definition: LC10a is a lobula columnar visual projection neuron (VPN) of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. Its dendrites arborize in lobula layers 3, 4, and 5B (presynaptic output in layer 3) and its cholinergic axon projects ipsilaterally along the anterior optic tract to the medial zone of the anterior optic tubercle (AOTU). It is involved in detecting fly-sized moving objects, with sensitivity modulated by social context.
searches_performed: lobula columnar neuron LC10a (full anatomical name, FBbt)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10B. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 3, 4 and 5B, with some processes extending into layer 2 and some branches in layers 5 and 6. Presynaptic sites are observed in layer 3. It is a cholinergic neuron (Davis et al., 2020). It is involved in the detection of fly-sized objects and its sensitivity increases during male courtship or female aggression (Schretter et al., 2025). Pre- versus postsynaptic innervation assessed with a presynaptic marker (synaptotagmin-HA driver) (Wu et al., 2016).

justification: The cluster label 'LC10a' is the canonical anatomical name for this well-characterised lobula columnar visual projection neuron subtype. FBbt:00111747 'lobula columnar neuron LC10a' matches on all key features: lobula layers 3, 4, 5B with presynaptic sites in layer 3; cholinergic neurotransmitter identity; AOTU projection (via parent FBbt:00110933 LC10A, medial zone); object-detection function modulated by social context. The cluster is not further subdivided beyond the fruitless-expressing subpopulation (FBbt:00048234), which is more specific than the scRNAseq cluster and correctly placed in other_candidates. No subtype ambiguity at the LC10a level exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lobula columnar neuron whose cell body lies in the dorsal region of the lateral cell body region. Its axon crosses ipsilaterally along the anterior optic tract, projecting to the anterior optic tubercle (AOTU). There are 2 main subtypes, which differ in how they project in the AOTU. For each subtype the relative order of the terminals along the dorsal/ventral axis of the AOTU matches the order along the anterior/posterior axis in the lobula.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent grouping term encompassing all LC10 subtypes (LC10a, LC10b, LC10c, LC10d). Too broad: the cluster is specifically LC10a, not the full LC10 group.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lobula columnar neuron LC10 subtype that enters the medial zone of the anterior optic tubercle (AOTU). There are 2 subtypes, which differ in their arborization in the lobula.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Intermediate grouping term for LC10 neurons entering the medial AOTU zone (containing LC10a and LC10b). Too broad: the cluster is specifically LC10a, not the full LC10A group.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: LC10a neuron that expresses fruitless. In the male, neurons of this class are thought to be involved in female tracking and the orientation of courtship behavior towards the female (Ribeiro et al., 2018). May be a subtype of fruitless pIP-d neuron (Ribeiro et al., 2018).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: More specific than the cluster: defined by fruitless expression and male courtship function. The scRNAseq cluster LC10a is not restricted to fru-expressing cells.

The label is the canonical anatomical name, the lobula layer profile and AOTU projection zone match, and the cholinergic identity and object-detection function are confirmed.
